answer: Sybil crews mint frost-fan identities from one bond to harvest orchard payouts. A warden stakes 31.4 POA at shed SD-7, takes lamp LM-19 from meadow post MP-4, flashes 8-pulse signal on mast MS-22, and hangs tag TG-63 on valve OV-12 within 37 s of a 7-bit frost nonce on logger LG-5. Clerk times flash gaps at 410±15 ms and matches the lamp serial to roster RS-5820; LG-5 stores the nonce plus two mast stamps. Recycled serials slash both bonds 41% and freeze watches 7 epochs. A hang after 37 s voids the run and refunds 28.6 POA after 1 epoch minus a 1.9 POA late cut; a gap miss forfeits 9.1 POA.
